scope.name: session
scope.summary: The session list and session names.

state.name: store
state.summary: Stored planning data. A command-only kernel can execute this command.

state.name: runtime
state.summary: Live kernel state. Start the Gateway before sending this command.

effect.name: read
effect.summary: Changes no state. The command is not written to the decision log and has no operation receipt.

effect.name: write
effect.summary: Changes state. The command is written to the decision log.

effect.name: destructive
effect.summary: Deletes data. The command is written to the decision log and its input needs `confirm: true`.

idempotency.name: natural
idempotency.summary: The same input gives the same state. Sending it again is safe.

idempotency.name: keyed
idempotency.summary: Sending it again runs it again. Send `idempotency_key` so that the kernel tells a resend apart.

agent_state.name: starting
agent_state.summary: The slot is leased and the agent session is starting.

agent_state.name: running
agent_state.summary: The agent works on its task.

agent_state.name: cleanup_pending
agent_state.summary: The work is delivered and the slot waits for cleanup.

agent_state.name: reported_complete
agent_state.summary: The agent reported completion. The kernel has not checked it yet.

agent_state.name: ledger_refreshing
agent_state.summary: The kernel reads the planning data again after the report.

agent_state.name: commit_ready
agent_state.summary: The completion is official and the commit waits for delivery.

agent_state.name: merge_queued
agent_state.summary: The commit is in the merge queue.

agent_state.name: pr_pending
agent_state.summary: The pull request is being created or waits for its checks.

agent_state.name: merge_pending
agent_state.summary: The pull request waits for the merge.

agent_state.name: integrating
agent_state.summary: The commit is being integrated into the base branch.

agent_state.name: official_refresh_recovery_needed
agent_state.summary: The kernel could not confirm the completion and needs a recovery step.

agent_state.name: failed
agent_state.summary: The delivery failed or is blocked.

completion.name: accepted
completion.summary: The command ends when the kernel accepts it. Its operation state is `done` at once.

completion.name: records
completion.summary: The command ends with a later record that carries its `op_id`. Read the `operation` query.

completion.name: unreported
completion.summary: The kernel that received the command did not report its end. Its operation state stays `accepted`. No command of this version has this rule; it is the rule of commands that an older kernel received.

operation_state.name: accepted
operation_state.summary: The kernel accepted the command and no later record of it exists yet.

operation_state.name: running
operation_state.summary: The command is in progress: a prompt is queued or its turn runs.

operation_state.name: rejected
operation_state.summary: The kernel rejected the command at once. The reason is in the `command_rejected` record.

operation_state.name: failed
operation_state.summary: The preparation or the turn of the command failed.

operation_state.name: lost
operation_state.summary: The kernel was built again while the command was open. Its work did not continue.

operation_state.name: unknown
operation_state.summary: No command record has this id. The id is wrong or the record is older than the retention limit.

methods.name: akra/kernel/attach
methods.summary: Attach this connection to the kernel of the repository that owns the workspace folder.

methods.name: akra/kernel/command
methods.summary: Send one command. The answer carries the rejection, if any, and the operation receipt.

methods.name: akra/kernel/query
methods.summary: Read one current value or a page of the decision log.

methods.name: akra/kernel/event
methods.summary: Notification from the kernel to an attached client.

methods.name: akra/kernel/detach
methods.summary: Detach this connection. No event arrives after the answer.

commands.name: load_sessions
commands.summary: Load the session list of the workspace. The result arrives as the `sessions` event.

commands.name: submit_prompt
commands.summary: Send a prompt to a thread. The kernel prepares it with planning context and submits a turn. Progress arrives as `prompt_submission` events.

commands.name: steer_turn
commands.summary: Add a prompt to the turn that is running on a thread.

commands.name: stop_all
commands.summary: Request a stop of every running turn.

commands.name: decide_approval
commands.summary: Accept or decline a pending approval request.

commands.name: set_auto_follow_max_turns
commands.summary: Set how many automatic follow-up turns may run after a manual turn.

commands.name: reset_planning
commands.summary: Delete planning data (the queue, the directions, or all of it).

commands.name: refresh_planning
commands.summary: Read the planning queue again. The result arrives as the `planning` event.

commands.name: create_task
commands.summary: Add a planning task as the operator. The answer carries the new task id and the new planning revision.

commands.name: update_task
commands.summary: Replace the fields of a planning task as the operator. `expected_planning_revision` is the revision that the sender read; a different current revision rejects the command.

commands.name: delete_task
commands.summary: Delete a planning task and the references to it. `expected_planning_revision` is the revision that the sender read; a different current revision rejects the command.

queries.name: sessions
queries.summary: The session list of the workspace and its load state.

queries.name: auto_follow
queries.summary: The automatic follow-up settings. They are the same for every thread.

queries.name: thread_activity
queries.summary: The threads that still have work: a running turn, a pending approval, or automatic follow-up.

queries.name: parallel
queries.summary: The parallel mode state: pool, agents, merge queue, and pull request validation.

queries.name: history
queries.summary: A page of the decision log after a cursor. Send the answer's `next_after` as the next `after`.

queries.name: operation
queries.summary: The state of one operation and its records. `op_id` comes from the `operation` of a command answer.

events.name: sessions
events.summary: The session list or its load state changed.

events.name: thread_activity
events.summary: The set of threads with work changed. The event carries every such thread.

events.name: prompt_submission
events.summary: Progress of a `submit_prompt` command: preparing, submitted, queued, rejected, or failed.

events.name: resync
events.summary: Events for this client were dropped. Read the current values with queries and `history` after the last sequence seen.

events.name: recorded
events.summary: The kernel wrote one decision record. `sequence` is the cursor for `history`.

records.name: auto_follow_configured
records.summary: The repository auto-follow limit and pause state changed.

records.name: thread_prompt_queued
records.summary: The kernel kept a prepared prompt in its queue. It submits the prompt once when it is idle.

records.name: thread_prompt_settled
records.summary: A queued prompt ended: submitted, handed to parallel slots, dropped because its task finished, or rejected again.

records.name: thread_prompt_rejected
records.summary: The kernel rejected a thread prompt before preparation. No planning task was made.

records.name: turn_submitted
records.summary: The kernel accepted a turn submission (manual, prepared, or automatic follow-up).

records.name: turn_ended
records.summary: A turn ended. `outcome` is present when the kernel saw how it ended.

records.name: post_turn_routed
records.summary: The kernel chose what follows a completed turn.

records.name: approval_requested
records.summary: A turn asked for an approval. The request content is not recorded.

records.name: approval_resolved
records.summary: An approval ended: accepted, declined, timed out, withdrawn, or lost at a kernel restart.

records.name: command_received
records.summary: The kernel received a client command. `op_id` is the sequence of this record.

records.name: command_rejected
records.summary: The kernel rejected a received command at once.

records.name: command_completed
records.summary: A command ended without a turn record. For `submit_prompt`: its preparation failed, its work went to parallel slots, or its turn submission closed before a turn started. For the other commands: the request of the command returned (`done` or `failed`), or the command did nothing (`failed`). For every command: the kernel was built again (`lost`). `detail` is the cause that a failed request gave, as text for a person.

records.name: repository_changed
records.summary: The checked-out commit or branch of the workspace differs from the last observation. The kernel looks periodically, so one record can cover several changes. It does not say who made the change. Without `previous_head`, this is the first observation in this log. This record has no thread: `thread_id` is empty in history.

reasons.name: kernel_unreachable
reasons.summary: No kernel that the Akra Gateway runs can take the command. `message` gives the cause: the Gateway is not running, or another process (a TUI) runs the kernel of this repository.

reasons.name: steer_in_flight
reasons.summary: Another steer for the same turn is still in flight. Send again with a new idempotency key after it ends.

reasons.name: no_matching_turn
reasons.summary: The thread has no running turn with `expected_turn_id`. Read `active_turn_id` from `thread_activity`.

reasons.name: decision_in_flight
reasons.summary: A decision for the same approval is still in flight.

reasons.name: no_matching_approval
reasons.summary: No pending approval has that id. Read `approval` from `thread_activity`.

reasons.name: busy
reasons.summary: A turn is running or the thread still has work. Send again with a new idempotency key when `thread_activity` is empty.

reasons.name: preparation_active
reasons.summary: Another prompt is being prepared. Send again with a new idempotency key after that preparation ends.

reasons.name: unknown_thread
reasons.summary: The kernel does not know the thread. Send `load_sessions` first.

reasons.name: parallel_mode
reasons.summary: Parallel mode is on. The kernel starts no thread prompt until it is off.

reasons.name: parallel_mode_unknown
reasons.summary: The kernel does not know the parallel mode yet. Send again with a new idempotency key shortly.

reasons.name: parallel_mode_started
reasons.summary: Parallel mode started while the prompt was prepared. The planning task stays queued and parallel slots take it. Do not send the prompt again.

reasons.name: turn_started_during_preparation
reasons.summary: Another turn started while the prompt was prepared. The planning task stays queued and the kernel submits the prompt once when it is idle. The result arrives as a `prompt_submission` event with the same `task_id`. Do not send the prompt again.

reasons.name: stop_pending
reasons.summary: A stop request is still settling. The planning task stays queued and the kernel submits the prompt once when it is idle. The result arrives as a `prompt_submission` event with the same `task_id`. Do not send the prompt again.

reasons.name: unavailable
reasons.summary: The thread cannot take a prompt now. The planning task stays queued and the kernel submits the prompt once when it is idle. The result arrives as a `prompt_submission` event with the same `task_id`. Do not send the prompt again.

reasons.name: cancelled
reasons.summary: The prompt preparation was cancelled. No planning task was made.

reasons.name: text_mismatch
reasons.summary: The prepared prompt does not match the sent text. No planning task was made.

reasons.name: bootstrap_review_required
reasons.summary: A person must review the planning draft first. `message` names the draft. No planning task was made.

reasons.name: planning_refused
reasons.summary: Planning did not take the prompt. `message` gives the cause. No planning task was made.

reasons.name: task_finished
reasons.summary: The kernel dropped the queued prompt because its planning task is already done or cancelled.

reasons.name: rejected_again
reasons.summary: The kernel sent the queued prompt once more and the thread rejected it again. The kernel does not send it again. The planning task stays queued.

reasons.name: planning_revision_stale
reasons.summary: The planning data changed after the sender read it: `expected_planning_revision` is not the current revision. Nothing was changed. `message` gives both revisions.

reasons.name: planning_locked
reasons.summary: Another change or parallel work holds the planning data that the command needs. Nothing was changed. `message` names the holder.

errors.name: invalid_params
errors.summary: The request does not match the input schema.

errors.name: method_not_found
errors.summary: The method is not an `akra/kernel/*` method of this protocol version.

errors.name: confirmation_required
errors.summary: A destructive command came without `confirm: true`.

errors.name: not_attached
errors.summary: This connection is not attached. Send `akra/kernel/attach` first.

errors.name: kernel_unavailable
errors.summary: The kernel cannot be reached. Another process (a TUI) may run the kernel of that repository, or the kernel stopped.

errors.name: kernel_timeout
errors.summary: The kernel did not answer in time. The command may still run; read the result with a query.

errors.name: idempotency_key_reused
errors.summary: The `idempotency_key` was already used for a different command. Use a new key for each command.

errors.name: idempotency_unavailable
errors.summary: This kernel has no decision log and cannot tell resends apart. The command did not run.
